subject: Rapid-fire POC credit top-up + trial extension request

Subject: Rapid-fire POC: short notice credit top-up and trial extension request

Hi Hannah —

We're ramping up a quick, 48-hour soak test next week to validate our real-time recommendation pipeline under burst traffic (night shift and early-morning windows). We need a short-notice promotional top-up or trial extension to run the test at target load: 1,000 RPS sustained small-ctx requests (~input ~120 tokens / output ~80 tokens). Goal: confirm p99 latency stays below 200ms and average cost per 1k requests stays within the forecasted budget.

Can Redwood provision an additional burst credit allocation and extend our trial window by 72 hours so we can run the test on Dec 16–17? We can share the detailed test plan and schedule. If helpful, procurement can sign a short addendum.

Quick details:
- Account: Quantate Labs
- Env: sandbox.quantate.redwood (we'll hit hosted endpoints)
- Expected consumption: ~200k tokens/day (rough estimate)

Appreciate any help — this POC is time-sensitive and will speed up our production go/no-go decision.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Engineering
Quantate Labs
[Attachment: quantate-poc-schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Alex —

Thanks for the clear summary and timeline. We can support this, but will need to coordinate a provisional promo top-up and a short trial extension with Sales Ops and our billing/legal team. Can you confirm:

1) Exact window you plan to run (start/end UTC)
2) Which model(s) you'll be calling and avg token sizes per call (you gave a rough estimate — we just need the software mapping so we pick the right quantization profile)
3) Any compliance constraints (PII, logs retention) for the sandbox requests

I'll loop in Marissa to request a provisional credit allocation and a 72-hour trial extension. We typically grant a temporary burst credit plus a targeted promo (covers estimated token usage) contingent on a signed short addendum for terms and liability. I can send the promo term sheet and the mutual action plan (MAP) for the run.

Proposed next steps (today):
- You send start/end UTC and model list
- We provision provisional credits and share the term sheet
- Procurement either signs the addendum or counters

I'll put Marissa on the thread.

—Hannah
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
